name: 配置轮动
description_zh: 基于宏观象限给出股/债/商品/现金/海外大类战略配置比例，并以"景气 + 估值 + 资金"三维打分输出行业超配/标配/低配轮动信号。补齐资产配置与行业轮动维度。
description_en: Provide strategic allocation ratios across asset classes (equities / bonds / commodities / cash / overseas) based on macroeconomic regimes, and output sector overweight / neutral / underweight rotation signals using a three-dimension scoring model (prosperity + valuation + capital flow). Covers both top-down asset allocation and sector rotation.
